result.title: Structure from Collision via Hypothesis-Space Reasoning
result.summary: Knowledge of the hidden interior structure of an object, including the presence and location of cavities, is essential for predictive simulation, robotic manipulation, and nondestructive inspection. However, such cavities leave no direct signature on the static visible surface, making collision-induced deformation one of the few cues used to infer their presence. Structure from Collision (SfC) addresses this problem by recovering the hidden interior structure of an object from multiview observations of a collision event. SfC is challenging for two reasons: hidden cavities are only indirectly observable through surface motion, and voids correspond to the absence of material, making direct optimization using standard density representations difficult. The density-based SfC baseline inherits both difficulties. Surface-matching gradients do not directly indicate the cavity location, while density gradients can be weak or uninformative inside or near void regions. Therefore, we reformulate SfC as hypothesis-space reasoning, representing hidden cavities as explicit structural hypotheses whose variables encode available structural assumptions rather than relying on implicit density updates. A global stage performs gradient-free optimization over this hypothesis space using forward-only material point method (MPM) simulation. A local stage then refines the selected hypothesis as a Lagrangian particle system through gradient-based optimization using differentiable MPM simulation. On the SfC benchmark, our method improves hidden-structure reconstruction and future prediction over the density-based SfC baseline. Interior-topology stress tests and robustness analyses characterize its scope and limitations. The project page is available at https://www.kecl.ntt.co.jp/people/kaneko.takuhiro/projects/sfc-hypothesis/.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究从碰撞形变的多视角观测中推断物体内部隐藏空腔（Structure from Collision），把这一逆问题重构为「假设空间推理」：先用显式结构假设变量取代隐式密度更新，通过仅前向的 MPM 仿真做无梯度全局搜索，再用可微 MPM 对选中假设做基于粒子的局部精化。
AI.relevance_reason: 其把不可直接观测的隐变量写成显式假设集、并以「无梯度搜索＋可微精化」两段式替代隐式密度优化，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的表示与候选假设搜索/验证提供问题表述上的启发，可供核查是否映射到视觉证据筛选与停止决策。
